property_summary: For any owner and any recipient contract with a reverting payable fallback, when Owner calls withdraw() on the correct contract (which uses transfer) the call either reverts (so contract balance remains unchanged) or succeeds and leaves address(c).balance == 0; the mutant that uses send and ignores the return can succeed (not revert) while leaving address(c).balance > 0 when the recipient reverts.
change_summary: Change transfer to use send and ignore its boolean result (using send instead of transfer alters failure behavior).
